scripts.bootstrap: mkdir -p node_modules/@types && ln -sf /opt/node22/lib/node_modules/ts-node/node_modules/@types/node node_modules/@types/node && ln -sf /opt/node22/lib/node_modules/playwright node_modules/playwright
scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/theme && cp index.html dist/index.html && cp src/theme/app.css dist/theme/app.css
